title: The locked-reread ownership check in breakStaleLock has both halves unpinned: the only interleaving test replaces the lock differing in pid AND stamp, so a pid-only or stamp-only mutant survives the suite

acceptanceCriteria.text: A case at the afterStaleJudgement seam replaces the judged-stale lock with one differing ONLY in pid, asserts breakStaleLock returns false and leaves that replacement lock on disk, and a mutation of the locked-reread comparison keeping only its pid half turns exactly that case red
A second case at the same seam replaces the judged-stale lock with one differing ONLY in stamp, asserts the same refusal, and a mutation keeping only the stamp half turns exactly that case red
The unmutated check leaves the suite green, and both mutation runs with their red counts are recorded in the implementation notes
